Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.recap

Class RecapCalculator

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.recap.RecapCalculator
@Component public class RecapCalculator extends Object
Works out a client's monthly recap from their fills and daily closing prices. Pure: no database or network, so every figure is tested on its own.

Each symbol's trading return for the month is 

   gain     = (units held at month end x end price + money from sells)
            - (units held at month start x start price + money spent on buys)
   invested = start value + money spent on buys so far - money from sells so far
   return   = gain / the most invested at any point in the month
Dividing by the peak rather than by every buy keeps money that is sold and bought back from counting twice, so a client who trades the same 1,000 in and out ten times is measured on 1,000, not 10,000. The client's trading return is the total gain over the total of those peaks, so a large position counts for more than a small one. A symbol is left out of every return when it can't be priced, or when the client's fills sell more units than they bought: the reporting schema then doesn't hold the whole history, and any return would be made up. Such symbols still count towards money moved, top tickers, instruments traded and sector.

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public RecapPayload calculate(YearMonth month, List<RecapFill> fills, PriceBook prices, Map<String,String> sectors)
      Works out one client's recap. The ranking is left unset; topPercents(java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, java.math.BigDecimal>) fills it in once every client's recap for the month is known.
      Parameters:
      month - the month to recap
      fills - the client's fills up to the end of the month, in any order; earlier months' fills give the units held when the month starts, later ones are ignored
      prices - daily closes for every symbol the client held or traded, and for the benchmark, from the last day of the month before through the month's last day
      sectors - GICS sector by trading symbol
      Returns:
      the recap, without a ranking

    • topPercents

      public Map<UUID,Integer> topPercents(Map<UUID,BigDecimal> tradingReturns)
      Ranks the month's clients by trading return. A client's top percent is the smallest top slice they are in: the best of 25 clients is in the top 4%. Tied clients share the better rank. Clients with no trading return aren't ranked and don't count towards anyone's slice.
      Parameters:
      tradingReturns - each client's trading return, null when they have none
      Returns:
      the top percent of each client in the top 50%; clients below that are left out, so the card never boasts about being in the top 90%

    • symbolsToPrice

      public Set<String> symbolsToPrice(YearMonth month, Collection<RecapFill> fills)
      The symbols a client's recap needs prices for: those traded in the month, and those held when it began. Symbols closed out earlier are left out, so a long history doesn't mean fetching prices nobody needs.
      Parameters:
      month - the month to recap
      fills - the client's fills, in any order
      Returns:
      the trading symbols to price
